_comment: Simple word filter for player text (chat, guild names, newspapers, cases). Case-insensitive, with common digit/symbol swaps (0=o, 1=i, 3=e, 4=a, 5=s, 7=t, @=a, $=s). A trailing * matches any word starting with it; otherwise whole words only. Names that hit the filter are refused; other text is starred out.
